verdict.rationale: Publishing operating hours, per-day limits, or session timeouts is a fair question for a government online-filing registry, so the axis applies. The evidence pack holds only two robots.txt probes that returned HTTP 403, and nothing in it shows whether the MCA flow publishes any such limits before a founder starts.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start
